name: DLF Central 67
summary: DLF's own press release confirms the project (SCO plotted commercial development), Sector 67 Sohna Road location, HARERA RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/768/500/2023/112 dated 04.12.2023 (promoter DLF Home Developers Ltd) and 8.69 acres; starting price Rs 8 Cr is within 15% of portal figures (~Rs 7.5-7.8 Cr). Minor issues: our '6 floors' is a basement + ground + 4 configuration (5 above-ground floors, 15 m height), we omit the ~79 SCO plots, and the possession date (Dec 2027 per a broker) could not be confirmed against RERA.
